en.title: "The Thief of All Faces" stops content updates, and the development team faces major layoffs
en.summary: OtherSide Entertainment has announced that its stealth-action theft game Faceless Thief will cease all content updates. Due to poor launch performance and poor reputation, some members of the development team have resigned. Due to the extremely small size of the remaining team, it is no longer feasible to continue developing new content and systems. Developers are working on new versions of the game to keep its base running. Going forward, publisher Megabit will take over full maintenance of the game. It is reported that the new version will no longer use dedicated cloud servers, but will switch to a peer-to-peer network to support cooperative connections. This structural adjustment will not change the actual gameplay experience, and the single-player mode will not be affected at all. "Face" was developed by Warren Spector and was originally planned to be a PvPvE game. Due to multiple reasons such as the sluggish environment of the game industry and the break in the development capital chain, the final content volume of "The Thief of All Faces" was finally reduced.
